model_annotation: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating negative log probability values for different “Per-specialty terms,” with results shown for a base model and multiple fine-tuned variants. The category axis is the horizontal axis labeled “Per-specialty terms,” and it displays six categories in left-to-right order: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics; the labels are shown at an angle but follow this sequence without additional sorting. The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “Negative log probability,” shown on a linear scale with tick labels at regular 1-unit intervals from approximately −22 at the top down to −27 at the bottom. Within each specialty category, there is a cluster of seven thin vertical bars arranged side-by-side: one light blue bar labeled in the legend as “MistralV0.2-Base,” followed by six bars in progressively darker warm tones corresponding to “Fine-tuned on:” Cardio (very light beige), Gastro (light tan), Infect (light orange), Neuro (medium orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across clusters, the bars generally fall within the plotted range of about −25.5 to −27.3 (reading from the axis ticks), with each specialty showing a similar set of seven values; no bars are outlined, annotated, or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the color-coding and the legend.
